class.name: ReloadedModel3D
class.brief_description: A model in the scene, drawn by the [ModelRenderingServer] instance it stands for.
class.description: A plugin's node derives from it, makes the instance, hands it over ([method set_model_instance]) and announces each new one ([signal model_instance_created]). The lights set here are that instance's.

method.name: _normalize_lights_state
method.description: The deriving node's say on a [member lights_state] set: what it stores and draws, the model's own lights in it, say. Without it the state is kept as it was set.

method.name: attach_signal_head
method.description: The model draws the [SignallingServer] signal head's lights, and frees it with them.

method.name: get_model_instance
method.description: Returns the [ModelRenderingServer] instance the node stands for, none until there is one.

method.name: set_model_instance
method.description: From the deriving node, whenever it has another instance. It sets the lights on it and announces it itself.

members.member: The model's lights dimmed, by name: [code]{light: bool}[/code], at [member lights_dimmed_multiplier].
How bright a dimmed light is.
The model's lights on or off, by name: [code]{light: bool}[/code].

signal.name: model_instance_created
signal.description: Emitted whenever the node has a new [ModelRenderingServer] instance - on the first load, on a reload, on re-entering the tree.
